# `candid followup`

Draft thank-you / check-in / referral emails.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid followup [-h] <subcommand> ...
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `thank-you` | Draft a post-interview thank-you email. |
| `check-in` | Draft a check-in email after applying. |
| `referral` | Draft a referral request. |


### `candid followup thank-you`

Draft a post-interview thank-you email.

```
usage: python -m candid followup thank-you [-h] --person PERSON --role ROLE --company COMPANY [--tone {warm,formal,concise}] [--topics TOPICS] [--standout STANDOUT]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--person` `PERSON` | Interviewer / recruiter / contact name (required) |
| `--role` `ROLE` | (required) |
| `--company` `COMPANY` | (required) |
| `--tone` `TONE` | (default: warm) |
| `--topics` `TOPICS` | - |
| `--standout` `STANDOUT` | - |
